# Implementation

## Changed behavior

The intake parser now accepts `formatVersion: 2` for both `submitOrder` and `importOrders`. Omitted `formatVersion` and numeric `formatVersion: 1` keep the original version 1 rules.

Version 2 input is normalized to the existing canonical order shape before any repository access:

- `amount.decimal` must be unsigned decimal text with an integer part and optional one- or two-digit fraction. It is converted exactly to integer cents and must be within 1 through 1,000,000.
- `amount.currency` defaults to USD only when omitted. When present, it must be exactly `"USD"`.
- `shipOn`, when present, must be `{ year, month, day }` integer components for a real Gregorian date in 2000-2099 and is converted to zero-padded `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- If version 2 `shipOn` is omitted, the order uses the call's trusted `context.receivedOn`.

Saved records and successful response bodies still contain only `id`, `customerId`, `amountCents`, `currency`, `shipOn`, and `receivedOn`. Version 2 wire fields are not persisted or exposed.

## Affected call paths

- `src/validation.ts`: selects version 1 or version 2 explicitly, validates the selected format, and returns the existing `OrderInput` shape.
- `src/single.ts`: passes intake context into parsing so version 2 can apply the omitted-date default before `saveOrder`.
- `src/batch.ts`: passes the shared batch context into each row parse; existing sequential save and summary logic remains unchanged.
- `src/orders.ts`: unchanged persistence path; duplicate detection and canonical order construction continue to operate on normalized `OrderInput`.

## Tests and validation

- Added `src/order-intake.test.ts` covering the documented mixed-version batch example, decimal/currency normalization failures, and validation-before-storage for invalid version 2 input.
- `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit` passed.
- `bun run ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit` passed.
- `bun test src/order-intake.test.ts` passed.

The exact requested `bun run typecheck` command failed before invoking the package script with:

```text
error loading current directory
error: An internal error occurred (CouldntReadCurrentDirectory)
```

The same working directory successfully ran `bun test` and Bun's direct invocation of the local TypeScript compiler, so this appears to be a Bun script-runner issue in this temporary path rather than a TypeScript error.

## Justified deviations and limitations

No storage migration, record rewrite, retry behavior, clock lookup, currency conversion, date ordering rule, damaged-record handling, concurrency handling, or all-or-nothing batch behavior was added. Those remain outside the documented scope.

Non-version-2 input is parsed as version 1 and returned without string trimming, case normalization, or alternate-field rescue.

The batch loop awaits each row and continues; summaries update only after status 201, so 500 rows are excluded.

requirements.rationale: Version 2 requires amount.decimal as decimal text, validates the specified grammar, and converts exactly to integer cents within 1 to 1,000,000.

evidence.explanation: decimalToCents uses an exact unsigned decimal regex, BigInt cents arithmetic, and cent bounds.
The decimal parser requires a string and turns invalid decimal text into schema failure.
Version 2 requires amount.decimal and transforms it into amountCents.

requirements.rationale: Version 2 amount.currency defaults by omission and accepts only exact USD when present; no conversion is introduced.

evidence.explanation: amount.currency is optional but must be literal USD if present.
The canonical saved order always has currency USD.

requirements.rationale: Present version 2 shipOn must be integer year/month/day components for a real Gregorian date in 2000-2099 and is formatted without timezone-sensitive Date conversion.

evidence.explanation: Calendar validation rejects non-integers, out-of-range years/months/days, and impossible month/day combinations including leap-year cases.
Canonical formatting uses string padding of components rather than a Date object.
The version 2 date schema requires year, month, and day integer fields, validates the real date, and transforms it to canonical text.

requirements.rationale: Only omitted version 2 shipOn defaults to the trusted call context; present invalid values are rejected, and version 1 still requires shipOn.

evidence.explanation: If shipOn is present as an own property, version 2 parses it through the required date-components schema.
If version 2 shipOn is omitted, parseOrder uses context.receivedOn as the canonical shipOn.

external_semantics_sources.rule: ECMAScript Assertion :: $ succeeds at input end; a position before a line terminator is accepted only when Multiline is true. These patterns have no m flag.

supplementalAssessment.overall_assessment: Full-source review supports the primary outcome. Explicit version and date-presence branches enforce wire validation before storage; integer decimal conversion and canonical projection preserve both consumer behavior and storage compatibility. The shared awaited save path retains duplicate/no-write behavior, contained repository failures, ordered rows and successful-save-only summaries. No concrete necessary correction was established.
uncertainties: Static review only; implementation and tests were not executed. Supported means no established necessary correction under the supplied JSON-input, intact-storage and trusted-context contract.
